name: Kurt Ahrens
features: dark hair, square jaw, broad shoulders, brisk manner
bio: Braunschweig's own, who drove Formula 2 Brabhams and then Porsche Salzburg's white 917s. Won the 1970 Nurburgring 1000 km with Vic Elford in a 908/03 and shared the long-tail 917 with him at Le Mans. Retired at the end of the year to run the family business, still only thirty.
